seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: January, October and December. Driest: May, June and July. Hottest: August (10.9°C average). Coolest: February (3.3°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: No FCDO advice page exists for Faroe Islands, and no official etiquette guidance has been checked yet. Ask locally. Visit Faroe Islands: stay on marked old village paths. There is no right to roam through private outfield or sheep land, so close gates and don't disturb sheep or birds. Some hikes charge a mandatory fee or need a guide (for example Kallur, Trælanípa and Drangarnir).
